title: Picture cards: weather symbols (sun, cloud, rain, wind)
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y1 lesson 101 (Picture cards: weather symbols (sun, cloud, rain, wind))
intro: Lesson 101: y says /igh/ and /ee/: sky, fly and sunny. To understand that y can say /igh/ (sky) and /ee/ (sunny)

blocks.title: Sort into: /igh/ as in sky / /ee/ as in sunny
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: /igh/ as in sky, /ee/ as in sunny.
blocks.answer: /igh/ as in sky: fly; dry; cry. /ee/ as in sunny: windy; rainy; cloudy

cards:
grapheme
the letters that write one
sound

y
a letter that can say /igh/ in
sky or /ee/ in sunny

weather
what the sky and air are like
each day: sunny, rainy, windy

forecast
words that say what the
weather will be like
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.model: I do: s-k-y: y says /igh/ at the end of a short word, sky.
I do first: sunny: s-u-nn-y; y says /ee/ at the end.

questions.q: write today's forecast with two y words
questions.a: For example: It is cloudy and dry.

questions.q: write a sentence with fly and windy
questions.a: For example: Birds fly on a windy day.
